a.text: Hoiberg arrived as head coach for the University of Nebraska mens basketball program.

b.text: Hoiberg was named head coach of the Nebraska Cornhuskers mens basketball team.
Iowa State University announced that Hoiberg would take over as head basketball coach.

a.text: Hoiberg led his basketball team to a state championship.

b.text: Hoiberg was honored as the State of Iowas Mr. Basketball.
